scripts.check: vp run -r build && vp fmt --check && vp run --filter './packages/*' --filter ./example/sqlite check
scripts.test: vp run -r build && vp run -r test
scripts.example: vp run -r build && vp run --filter ./example/sqlite check
scripts.example:mysql: vp run -r build && vp run --filter ./example/mysql check
scripts.example:postgres: vp run -r build && vp run --filter ./example/postgres check
scripts.release: changeset publish && pnpm --filter vscode-inferql run publish:marketplace
